business_summary: COFCO Technology & Industry Co., Ltd., a scientific and technological company, operates as an agricultural food engineering technology service provider in China and internationally. The company engages in the design consulting business, including engineering design and engineering consulting in the field of agricultural and food product processing engineering; and agricultural and food product processing engineering technology services, including project consulting, engineering design, technical equipment research and development, equipment manufacturing, equipment sets and supply, and equipment installation. It is also involved in the research, development, production, sale, and maintenance of agricultural and food processing engineering products, such as dryers, flour post-processing equipment, milling machines, square screens, powder cleaners, extractors, oil presses, extruders, cans, and other related products. In addition, the company engages in public building design; project supervision; research development and application; biomedical engineering; oil storage and transport; inspection and testing; and magazine publishing. Further, it offers wheat, rice, oil, and food processing; cold chain; grain warehouse logistics; public building design; and special refrigeration services. Additionally, the company is involved in general engineering contracting, engineering supervision, mechanical and electrical equipment manufacturing, and other business, such as logistics, cold chain, and storage and deep processing technology in the grain and oil industry, including wheat, rice, oil, fat, feedstuff, meat, and other agricultural products. The company was formerly known as COFCO Engineering & Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to COFCO Technology & Industry Co., Ltd. in September 2022. COFCO Technology & Industry Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Wuxi, China.
business_summary_ko: 과학 기술 회사인 COFCO Technology & Industry Co., Ltd.는 중국 및 국제적으로 농업 식품 공학 기술 서비스 제공업체로 활동하고 있습니다. 회사는 농업 및 식품 가공 엔지니어링 분야의 엔지니어링 설계 및 엔지니어링 컨설팅을 포함한 디자인 컨설팅 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 프로젝트 컨설팅, 엔지니어링 설계, 기술 장비 연구 및 개발, 장비 제조, 장비 세트 및 공급, 장비 설치를 포함한 농업 및 식품 가공 엔지니어링 기술 서비스. 또한 건조기, 밀가루 후처리 장비, 밀링 기계, 정사각형 스크린, 분말 세척제, 추출기, 오일 프레스, 압출기, 캔 및 기타 관련 제품과 같은 농업 및 식품 가공 엔지니어링 제품의 연구, 개발, 생산, 판매 및 유지 관리에도 참여하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 공공 건물 설계에도 참여하고 있습니다. 프로젝트 감독; 연구 개발 및 응용; 의생명공학; 석유 저장 및 운송; 검사 및 테스트; 그리고 잡지 출판. 또한 밀, 쌀, 기름 및 식품 가공품도 제공합니다.
